title: Preserve the Cloudflare AIChatAgent static boundary

requirementAssessments.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml registers SupportAgent at /src/support-agent.ts and loadSupportInstruction at /src/instructions.ts, while open-request-tools records createRuntimeTools as unresolved. The source confirms runtime-spread tools in the direct streamText request. Deterministic validation passed.

step-support registers only the cloudflare-agents runtime and StepSupportAgent binding. No instructionLoader is declared. /src/step-support-agent.ts confirms prepareStep can supply replacement instructions. Deterministic validation passed.

delegating-support preserves delegate_support's implementation, registration, input schema, and output schema bindings. No handoff or routing target is declared. The source shows an ordinary AI SDK function tool whose implementation merely references StepSupportAgent.

/src/indirect-agent.ts and /src/unsupported-output-agent.ts remain present, while moldea/moldea.yaml registers neither class and declares no runtime or object-schema relationship for them. Workspace assertions show both source files unchanged.
/src/workflow-agent.mts still defines RuntimeInitializedAgent with an executable initializedAt field, but the manifest does not register it. Workspace assertions show the source unchanged.

support and step-support both reference runtime id cloudflare-agents, and moldea/runtimes/cloudflare-agents.md is the sole runtime Markdown file. It covers static-boundary alternatives, Durable Object bindings, append-only new_sqlite_classes migrations, provider configuration, and coordinated Worker deployment responsibilities.

moldea/moldea.yaml contains only support.unresolved.open-request-tools, with /src/support-agent.ts and a resolution. step-support has no unresolved entry for prepareStep instruction replacement. The runtime guide mentions prepareStep but does not name /src/step-support-agent.ts or provide a focused resolution. The workspace patch changed only the manifest and runtime guide, so no other changed canonical file supplies the missing warning.
